tools.name: list_countries
tools.description: Every country with businesses listed on Nearwick, with how many each lists and the address of its directory.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The kinds of business a country lists, each group with its subcategories and counts, and the towns and regions with the most listings. Use a category slug with search_businesses.

tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search one country's listed businesses by words, category, town or region, and what the page carries. Returns up to 24 a page, each with its Nearwick page address to cite. Word searches default to best match; browsing without words defaults to A to Z. You can also request A to Z or newest details fi
